description:
About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

We are looking for a motivated and detail oriented Marketing Operations Intern with a strong focus on finance and procurement processes. In this role, you will support budget management, financial analysis, and vendor coordination to ensure smooth operations between marketing, finance, and procurement teams. You will also contribute to process automation that would help generate business insights that improve decision making.

This role is a great opportunity to understand how a large Marketing organization operates behind the scenes, gain exposure to different stakeholders and develop strong operational, analytical and problem solving skills.

In this role, you'll be...


Supporting budget management and tracking, helping maintain accurate visibility of marketing spend, commitments, pending items and budget execution 
Managing key procurement and vendor processes, including purchase requests, POs, contracts and approval follow-ups.
Supporting billing, reconciliation and payment processes, ensuring invoices are correctly matched against POs, approved scopes and previous billings.
Maintaining accurate operational controls and trackers, proactively identifying pending items, aging, deadlines and potential risks.
Working closely with the Senior Marketing Operations Analyst and cross functional teams such as Finance, Procurement and Legal to solve operational issues and keep processes moving on time.
Identifying opportunities to simplify, standardize and automate processes, using data, technology and AI to make our ways of working more efficient.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


You are currently pursuing a degree in Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Finance, Business or a related field.
You are comfortable working with numbers and data and have strong interest in forecasting processes, accruals/amortization, P&L statements, and budget management tools. Have strong attention to detail and good knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets.
You are highly organized, proactive and comfortable managing multiple priorities and deadlines at the same time.
You are curious, enjoy solving problems and challenging existing ways of working, and are always looking for opportunities to improve.
You are comfortable using AI tools in your day-to-day work and are curious about how AI can be used to analyze information, automate repetitive tasks and improve productivity.
You are comfortable communicating in English and Spanish in a professional environment.
Previous internship or work experience is a plus, but not required — we care more about your learning agility, ownership and willingness to grow.



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

We are looking for someone who is hands-on, creative, curious, and already uses tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI platforms as part of their daily work.

This is a practical, execution-focused role covering content, social media, AI search visibility, marketing analytics, and marketing operations. You will use AI throughout your workflow to research, create, design, analyze, automate, and improve marketing initiatives.

Your focus will be Azumo. You will learn about our business, customers, services, and market and use that knowledge to expand our reach, strengthen our brand, and generate new opportunities.

You will work closely with the marketing, sales, and leadership teams and have access to leading paid AI, marketing, content, analytics, and creative tools.

We care about how you work, not just which tools you have used.

We want someone who can take an idea and turn it into something real. You should be comfortable researching a topic, creating the content and visuals, publishing or launching the work, measuring the results, and improving the next iteration.

Azumo is looking for a highly motivated AI-Powered Marketing Analyst to join our marketing team and help grow the Azumo brand and business.

The role is fully remote across Latin America , aligned to your working day.

We are looking for someone who is hands-on, creative, curious, and already uses tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI platforms as part of their daily work.

This is a practical, execution-focused role covering content, social media, AI search visibility, marketing analytics, and marketing operations. You will use AI throughout your workflow to research, create, design, analyze, automate, and improve marketing initiatives.

Your focus will be Azumo. You will learn about our business, customers, services, and market and use that knowledge to expand our reach, strengthen our brand, and generate new opportunities.

You will work closely with the marketing, sales, and leadership teams and have access to leading paid AI, marketing, content, analytics, and creative tools.

What We’re Looking For

We care about how you work, not just which tools you have used.

We want someone who can take an idea and turn it into something real. You should be comfortable researching a topic, creating the content and visuals, publishing or launching the work, measuring the results, and improving the next iteration.

AI should already be a natural part of that process for you.

At the same time, we are not looking for someone who simply generates content and publishes it. Strong judgment, creativity, attention to quality, and an understanding of the audience are essential.

Azumo offers an opportunity to build your marketing career inside a technology company where AI is part of the everyday work.

You Will Have The Opportunity To

Access leading paid AI, marketing, analytics, content, and creative tools.

Work across social media, content, analytics, GEO/AEO, and emerging AI marketing channels.

Experiment with new tools and approaches in real marketing initiatives.

Focus on growing one company and one brand: Azumo.

Work Closely With Experienced Team Members And Company Leadership.

Take ownership of projects and see the direct impact of your work.

Receive training and mentored career development.

Develop skills in emerging areas of marketing as AI changes how people search, discover, and evaluate companies.

Responsibilities

Use ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools daily for research, content creation, creative development, analysis, and marketing operations.

Create and repurpose content for LinkedIn and other social media channels, including posts, graphics, carousels, and short-form content.

Create AI-generated images, videos, and other visual content using modern AI creative tools.

Develop and improve articles, case studies, newsletters, presentations, one-pagers, landing pages, and other marketing assets.

Implement GEO and AEO strategies to improve Azumo’s visibility in AI-powered search platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity.

Monitor how Azumo and its competitors appear across traditional and AI search, identify content gaps, and turn those insights into actionable content improvements.

Use AI and analytics tools to build recurring reports covering traffic, social media, campaigns, leads, conversions, AI search visibility, and other relevant marketing KPIs.

Identify opportunities to automate repetitive marketing tasks and improve existing workflows.

Support other marketing initiatives in collaboration with the marketing, sales, and leadership teams.

Requirements

Mandatory Qualifications

Expert-level English proficiency, both written and conversational.

3+ years of hands-on marketing experience, along with practical experience using generative AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude.

Strong, well-rounded understanding of marketing language, principles and strategy.

Experience creating content for LinkedIn and other social media channels, such as Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, Reddit, or similar platforms.

Comfortable working with marketing data, KPIs, reporting, and performance analysis.

Strong judgment, creativity, attention to detail, and the ability to improve AI-generated work before publication.

Ability to evaluate marketing ideas critically and distinguish between activity, engagement, and meaningful business impact.

Other Qualifications

Ability to connect marketing activities to business objectives and understand how different marketing channels work together.

Experience using ChatGPT, Claude, or similar generative AI tools for research, content creation, design, video production, analysis and marketing operations.

Working experience with HubSpot Marketing Hub.

Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and take ownership of projects in a remote environment.

Understanding of GEO, AEO, SEO, and AI search visibility.

Experience with paid advertising, including Google Ads, Meta Ads, Bing Ads, or emerging AI advertising platforms.

Experience with Webflow or a similar website content management system.

Experience with Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Webmaster Tools and similar analytics platforms.

Experience creating AI-assisted workflows or marketing automations.

At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.




Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.




When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.




ABM Manager at BairesDev




In this role, you'll be the closest partner our commercial teams have inside Growth Marketing, working daily with US-based sales and account leaders. This is a hands-on individual contributor position that blends account-based campaign execution with building the AI-powered automations that tell sellers exactly when to act. This is your opportunity to shape how data and AI directly drive new deals and account expansion, using tools like Claude as part of your daily workflow.




What You'll Do:




- Plan and run account-based campaigns for target and existing accounts across email, LinkedIn messaging, LinkedIn Ads, and direct mail, coordinated with each account's sales owner.

- Map commercial processes with sales and account teams and build automations (CRM, Clay, n8n/Make/Zapier, LLM steps) that detect account signals and alert sellers when to take action.

- Build and maintain the data behind these programs, including target-account lists, buying committees, and enriched account and contact records in CRM portals.

- Report weekly to commercial leaders on outcomes, including meetings booked, opportunities created, deals accelerated, accounts expanded, and revenue influenced.

- Test new channels and plays beyond the core four, such as event follow-up, video, or retargeting, and scale the ones that move pipeline.




What we are looking for:




- 2+ years running account-based marketing (ABM) programs in direct partnership with sales or account management teams, including co-selecting target accounts, building joint account plans, and reporting account-level pipeline or expansion to sales leaders.

- 2+ years building automations used by sellers, such as signal/trigger-based workflows, data enrichment, and lead/account routing with tools like Clay, n8n, Make, Zapier, HubSpot, or Salesforce workflows.

- 2+ years working with US-based commercial teams or marketing to US B2B buyers.

- Hands-on experience executing multi-channel campaigns across at least three of: email sequences, LinkedIn messaging, LinkedIn Ads, and direct mail/gifting, with email sequences and LinkedIn required.

- Daily, hands-on use of generative AI or LLM tools (Claude preferred; ChatGPT or Gemini accepted) inside automations, not only for writing copy.

- Native or bilingual proficiency in English.




Nice to have:




- Industrial or process engineering background, or documented process-mapping work (BPMN, swimlanes in Lucidchart/Miro) used to design sales or marketing workflows.

- Experience in B2B tech services, IT staffing, or nearshore/outsourcing companies.

- Background running campaigns aimed at existing accounts, such as expansion, cross-sell, or renewal plays with account managers.

- Familiarity with intent data or ABM platforms (6sense, Demandbase, ZoomInfo, Bombora, Common Room).

- Scripting experience for automations (Python, JavaScript, or SQL; APIs and webhooks).




How we do make your work (and your life) easier:




- 100% remote work (from anywhere).

- Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred

- Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.

- Flexible hours: create your own schedule.

- Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.

- Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.

description:
Job Description

About us

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.

Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.

Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

Purpose of the Role

Regional content studios are part of MOM's regional hubs, helping markets deliver the right content faster through greater reuse, better coordination and consistent ways of working. They focus primarily on adapting global content for local markets, while supporting local brand content where needed, using the tools, capabilities and processes defined by the central team. Diageo teams lead the studio, while agency partners deliver creative adaptation and production.

The Regional Content Operations Lead manages content demand and delivery for assigned categories across markets. This role is the day-to-day link between market and brand teams and the agency delivery team, reviewing briefs, challenging low-value requests, maximising reuse, choosing the right delivery route and ensuring assets are delivered on time and ready for approval, storage and reuse.

Key Accountabilities


Manage content demand and delivery for assigned categories, with a primary focus on adapting GBT assets for market use.
Review and clarify briefs from markets and brand teams, challenging unclear, duplicated or low-value asks and improving briefing quality over time.
Check for reuse before production and decide the most efficient route: reuse, GBT asset adaptation, Pencil/AI production, agency production or new-to-world only where truly needed.
Translate market needs into clear agency briefs, including assets, formats, mandatories, timelines, approval needs, delivery route and creative direction.
Guide the agency on workflows, templates, production approach and adaptation requirements, reviewing outputs where needed to ensure they are fit for purpose.
Track status, risks and missing inputs through the Planning & Briefing Platform, escalating issues and ensuring final assets are ready for approval, storage, tagging and reuse.


Key Competencies


 Brand Proposition
 Brand Activation


Qualifications And Experience Required


CONTENT DELIVERY EXPERIENCE: 6+ years of experience in content delivery, creative operations, marketing operations, agency account management, brand management, production or regional marketing.
CREATIVE JUDGMENT: Strong in-house or creative agency background, with the ability to understand briefs, judge outputs, provide clear feedback and bridge brand teams and agency partners.
BRIEFING & ADAPTATION EXPERTISE: Strong understanding of content briefing, reuse, adaptation, production workflows, approval requirements and market delivery needs.
AI & TOOL KNOWLEDGE: Good working knowledge of AI-enabled production, Pencil or similar tools, DAM/Libraries and content planning platforms.
PROJECT MANAGEMENT: Able to manage multiple briefs, deadlines, stakeholders and agency workflows at the same time.
PUSHBACK & EXECUTION: Detail-oriented and confident challenging weak briefs or unnecessary new creation, with focus on speed, reuse, cost efficiency, quality and market service.


Diversity Statement

Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.

We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.

Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.

If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.

Recruitment Scam Warning

Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we'll never ask for money.

title: Editorial Content Specialist (SEO & AEO)
description:
For the curious writers and search obsessed.

You know that feeling when you search for something and find an article that actually answers your question, no robotic filler, no keyword stuffing, just great taste and genuine utility? That’s the exact energy we care about.

We’re looking for an Editorial Content Specialist who loves the sweet spot where storytelling meets search intelligence. Someone who crafts pieces creative pros actually want to read, while understanding how modern search and answer engines discover and surface that work.

A Little About Us

Envato is an all-in-one creative toolkit, bringing together world-class creative assets and purpose-built AI tools to help people make their ideas real.

Our community is made up of designers, filmmakers, editors and creators who care about craft, love experimenting and are always looking for the next tool, technique or spark of inspiration to make better work.

What’s the gig?

You’ll be creating and editing tutorials, guides, and articles that solve real problems for creative pros. You’ll be digging into search trends and AI search behaviours to find untapped content gaps, producing fresh pieces that rank in traditional search and get cited in AI answer overviews.

You’ll be using generative AI daily to speed up your ideation and drafting, always backing it up with your sharp editorial eye so everything sounds human, clear, and on-brand.

You’ll also be publishing directly in WordPress, curating visuals from Envato, optimising internal links, and checking performance data to iterate on what works best alongside our Search Visibility team and external contributors.

Sound like you?

You have 5+ years of experience in writing, content marketing, or editorial roles, ideally within creative tools or tech. You know organic search inside out and already understand how answer engine optimization (AEO) and AI summaries work.

Generative AI is a natural part of your daily creative workflow, you’re confident managing content in WordPress, and you communicate fluently in both English and Spanish. Most of all, you bring strong editorial judgement and take pride in work that real humans enjoy reading.

Show Us What You’ve Got

Send us 2–3 writing samples or live links you’re proud of that showcase your editorial tone, storytelling skills, and how you explain creative concepts clearly.

Life at Envato

We’re a purpose-driven company and we’ve long embraced flexible, inclusive ways of working. We’re proud of the connected culture we’ve built across our global team. Our values  : Customer First, Build our Future, Make it Happen and Embrace Diversity guide everything we do, shaping how we work and grow.

Our benefits in Mexico include 30 days of Christmas bonus pay, 12 days of vacation in your first year, a 100% vacation bonus, monthly grocery vouchers, a 5% savings fund, private health insurance, home office, team connection & learning budgets, wellbeing and study support, volunteer leave, generous paid parental leave, access to all our products, the option to apply to work from another remote location for up to 3 months per year, plus our Conoce México benefit to help you explore more of Mexico.

A few things before you apply

We embrace diversity at Envato and want to ensure that everyone who applies for a role with us has an inclusive experience. Hiring for us isn't a tick box exercise, we want to know what you're passionate about, what our lived experiences are and what you think you can add to the team. We're also big believers in using AI, and that includes how we hire. We may use AI tools to help support our recruitment process, but they don't replace human judgement. Our people always make the final hiring decisions.

By submitting your application, you agree to our Privacy Policy . We encourage you to read it before applying to understand how we collect, use and handle your personal information. We appreciate the time you’ve taken to apply to Envato and we're committed to responding to every applicant.

You can read more about us on our blog, including news of our acquisition by Shutterstock Inc in 2024.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Manager and B2B Growth Consultant based in Mexico.

In this role, you will manage and grow a portfolio of B2B clients, helping businesses achieve predictable and sustainable revenue growth. You will act as a strategic partner to founders, executives, and sales leaders, translating their commercial objectives into effective growth strategies. Working with an established outbound engine combining software, AI, and operational expertise, you will coordinate campaign execution and drive measurable results. You will take ownership of client relationships from initial strategy workshops through long-term account development. This position offers direct exposure to ambitious B2B businesses, close collaboration with leadership, and the opportunity to build a valuable professional network. Your impact will be reflected in client retention, account expansion, and overall portfolio performance.

Accountabilities

As an Account Manager and B2B Growth Consultant, you will take full ownership of your client portfolio, combining strategic consulting, relationship management, and commercial development.


Lead strategic workshops with clients to define target audiences, positioning, messaging, and growth objectives. 
Develop tailored B2B acquisition strategies aligned with each client's business model and commercial priorities. 
Coordinate campaign implementation with internal teams responsible for technical execution. 
Monitor campaign performance, analyze results, and identify actionable opportunities for continuous improvement. 
Conduct regular client review calls, address questions, communicate progress, and ensure agreed next steps are delivered. 
Proactively manage client relationships, take ownership of challenges, and maintain high levels of customer satisfaction. 
Identify opportunities for account expansion and recommend relevant additional services and solutions. 
Develop successful client relationships into case studies, referrals, and long-term business partnerships. 
Contribute directly to portfolio growth through retention, upselling, and measurable client outcomes. 


Requirements

You bring relevant B2B experience and a strong understanding of customer relationships, business development, and commercial growth. You are comfortable working with senior decision-makers and taking ownership of client outcomes.


At least 2 years of experience in Account Management, Consulting, Customer Success, Sales, or a related B2B environment. 
Proven experience managing direct client relationships and taking responsibility for business outcomes. 
Ability to communicate confidently and effectively with founders, managing directors, and sales leaders. 
Understanding of B2B customer acquisition, sales processes, and business development strategies. 
Ability to quickly understand new business models and translate commercial challenges into practical solutions. 
A track record of measurable achievements, supported by concrete examples of previous results. 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both German and English. 
Strong ownership mentality, ambition, discipline, and a continuous improvement mindset. 
Openness to feedback and the ability to translate it into meaningful improvements. 
Excellent organizational skills and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. 
Reliability, accountability, and a strong commitment to delivering on promises. 


Career Changers: Candidates without direct experience in Account Management or B2B Growth may also be considered if they demonstrate exceptional performance in another demanding environment, such as management consulting. You should have outstanding learning agility, strong persuasion skills, and the confidence to develop expertise quickly.

Benefits


Competitive earning potential: €7,500–€10,000+ OTE per month after the ramp-up period, depending on portfolio size and individual performance. 
Uncapped commission: Earn performance-based commissions on client retention, upselling, and measurable results, with no fixed earnings ceiling. 
Fully remote flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world. 
Permanent employment contract: Long-term professional stability. 
Full-time position: 40 hours per week. 
Paid time off: 24 days of annual leave. 
Advanced technology: Access to proprietary software, an established outbound engine, and clearly defined processes. 
Dedicated operational support: Collaborate with a team responsible for technical implementation and campaign execution. 
Direct leadership exposure: Work closely with the founder and consulting team. 
Strong professional network: Build relationships with founders, executives, and decision-makers across a wide range of B2B businesses. 
High-performance environment: Join an ambitious startup culture focused on ownership, accountability, execution, and exceptional results. 
Growth opportunities: Build and develop your own client portfolio while directly contributing to business growth.

description:
Your work days are brighter here.

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

About The Team

The Workday Success Plans Team are all about our customers and their post Go-Live journey - we create programs to help them drive business value from their Workday applications. The team is responsible for delivering a variety of programs and services to our customers ranging from feature demonstrations to full feature deployments.

About The Role

Would you enjoy learning new things in a fast paced environment? Do you have an appetite for variety and challenging business problems to solve? Are you a great communicator who can clearly articulate and demonstrate the value of Workday solutions to our customers? The Workday Success Plans team works directly with customers through targeted microconsulting engagements to help solve their business needs using the Workday application.

As a Sr Functional Consultant, you will be responsible for acting as a trusted Workday advisor, you will have the opportunity to assist customers with how-to questions, troubleshoot and guide customers through configuration, and provide feature demonstrations. As a Workday expert, customers will benefit from your knowledge as you share your experience, identify key considerations, and highlight standard methodologies.

Our team of professionals have a broad and deep understanding of Workday, and enjoy the reward of helping customers solve problems, learn about new features, and find greater value in their Workday investment. So if you are passionate about the value technology can bring to an organization, love learning and want to work directly with some of the greatest companies on the planet, bring your energy and teamwork to the Workday Success Plans team!

Primary responsibilities of this role include delivering various services to Workday Success Plans customers. To be successful, this requires:


 Conducting research to ensure understanding of customer questions and related Workday concepts.
 Delivering small scope consulting in response to customer requests; providing configuration guidance, demonstrations, considerations, tips & tricks.
 Troubleshooting product configuration to resolve or provide optimal product configuration to meet customer business requirements.
 Clearly and effectively communicating responses and value to customers.
 Creating and delivering customer presentations on how to use Workday features to achieve business goals (Accelerator Webinars).
 Providing one-on-one consulting guidance to accelerate customer feature adoption (Feature Accelerator).
 Reviewing customer tenants to identify adoption opportunities (Feature Adoption Tenant Reviews).
 Completing and maintaining product expertise and Workday Certification(s) along with familiarity with Workday roadmap.
 Keeping up to date with industry practices and the ability to engage with our customers on those topics.
 Helping drive the creation of new programs to drive customer feature adoption.


In addition to delivering Workday Success Plans services, our Workday professionals will also deliver other Customer Enablement services, such as:


 Office Hours to conduct appointment-based consulting engagements providing guidance and product expertise to customers
 Perform configuration and business requirements reviews with a detailed deliverable calling out opportunities for optimization
 Provide one-on-one customer configuration designs
 Deployments including full deployment of Workday features
 Ability to travel up to 10%


About You

Basic Qualifications


 3+ years of experience in a functional consulting, implementation, or customer-facing advisory role within HCM, Compensation, or enterprise software systems (Workday, PeopleSoft, SAP, Oracle, and/or JD Edwards)
 2+ years of software consulting experience


Other Qualifications


 Workday Certification, or ability to certify, in at least one of the following: HCM, Compensation, Learning, Recruiting, or Talent
 Skilled in relationship management, with a track record of building trust with customers and acting as a go-to advisor on their business needs
 Experienced in requirements gathering, with the ability to research and clarify customer questions to uncover the true business need behind a request


Our Approach to Flexible Work

With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.

Job Description

Como Business Intelligence Junior estarás en una posición técnico-operativa enfocada en la ejecución cotidiana de proyectos de visualización de datos, preparación de fuentes de información de medios digitales y soporte a marcos de medición. Este rol apoya directamente al manager en la integración de datos provenientes de plataformas publicitarias (Meta, TikTok, Search, Programmatic) y herramientas de analítica digital (GA4, Appsflyer) para transformarlos en reportes claros y dashboards funcionales. Es una posición ideal para un profesional en desarrollo que busca consolidar sus habilidades en Business Intelligence aplicado al Marketing Digital (Investment Analytics).

Responsabilidades


Desarrollo de Reportes con Enfoque Visual: Diseñar, construir y actualizar dashboards en Tableau, Power BI o Looker Studio, aplicando nociones básicas de Data Storytelling para estructurar la información de forma lógica, clara y limpia.
Integración y Extracción de Datos: Apoyar en la conexión, limpieza y validación de fuentes de datos de marketing digital (GA4, Meta, TikTok, Appsflyer, Google Ads, Programmatic, etc.) utilizando consultas de datos básicas para garantizar reportes precisos y consistentes.

Familiaridad con métricas y estructuras de datos provenientes de plataformas de activación digital (Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Google Search/Display, Programmatic, GA4, Appsflyer, etc.).
Entendimiento general de los canales de medios pagados (Search, Social, Display, Video, Programmatic) y las palancas que un digital marketer opera para influir en los resultados.

title: Account Management Assistant (Mexico)
description:
Channel Factory provides intelligent marketing solutions for the next generation of contextual safety, suitability, and performance for brands and agencies. Our platform helps marketers implement, automate, and scale their marketing programs across the world's largest video library, YouTube and emerging growth channels. We sit at the intersection of marketing and suitability and have a mission of enabling the world's top brands to consciously connect with the right audience in the right context, maximizing suitability and contextual performance.

Channel Factory embodies a strong start‑up culture that values diversity, collaboration, and results. Our bias towards execution balances critical thinking, analysis, and pragmatic problem solving. We expect a lot from one another and value our thoughtful and intellectually curious company culture.

The Assistant Account Manager will be an eager to learn professional, seeking to learn and grow and become the expert in the video marketing offerings and capabilities of YouTube and off-YouTube platforms. Through meticulous attention to detail, he/she can manage multiple complex projects with ease – whether they call for organizational skills, statistical analysis, or business acumen – and is always ready and excited to hit the ground running.

The primary responsibility of the role is to assist Channel Factory's Account Manager in daily deliverables needed from clients or internal projects.

Responsibilities

Compiling insightful weekly, monthly, and/or Final Reports in MS Excel or MS Powerpoint

Minute note-taker for POD meetings

Submitting IOs for signature and inputting details into SFDC

Tracking performance, delivery, and margin goals for the POD to ensure we are on track with goals & benchmarks

Assisting with ad-hoc client requests with Account Manager leading client communication

Developing targeting lists by audience and brand relevancy

Leading campaign screenshots for proof of purchase with clients

Researching and staying up to date with relevant trends

Working with the Designer in creating brand safe screenshots for campaign POPs

Monitoring pacing and margin reports for regional campaigns

Assisting in special projects as assigned by AM-MGMT

All other duties assigned

Requirements

Fluency in English both written and verbal

EXPERIENCE: 0‑1 years of digital media experience

Strong work ethic & discipline to work productively in a remote environment

Proficiency in video conferencing and messaging apps e.g., Zoom, Google Hangouts, Slack

Advanced knowledge of Excel calculations, pivot tables, and graphs is a must!

Bonus points if you are AdWords or YouTube certified!

Have a thirst to learn the digital landscape and share with the team

A self‑directed professional who knows what needs to be done and operates with a sense of urgency, focus, and discipline

Able to effectively prioritize and work with little to no supervision

Highly organized and detail‑oriented professional

Have strong communication skills; verbal, written, interpersonal, and presentation

A collaborative individual who can work both in a team and independently

Driven and determined to learn and adapt in a face‑paced digital world

Above all, possess the highest levels of professionalism, integrity, and ethics

Benefits

Work with a leading startup in a high‑demand industry, and you would be working with like‑minded experts aiming to transform video ad operations

Competitive salary

Work‑life flexibility – we value your contributions above all

About Channel Factory

Founded in 2010, Channel Factory is an award‑winning marketing technology company that helps top global brands and agencies maximize YouTube advertising.

Recognized as a technology innovator by Cynopsis and one of the fastest‑growing companies by Inc., Channel Factory has served over three hundred of the Fortune 500 in delivering scalable, brand‑safe, contextually aligned YouTube advertising software and services.

By tapping into the deepest proprietary data pool on the market, the company enables highly customized, contextually aware, and dynamically optimized campaigns and provides industry‑leading performance for a portfolio of clients across all industries.

Channel Factory is an equal‑opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Channel Factory makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time. The company also has employee resource groups focusing on encouraging inclusion and diversity in the workplace.

title: CRM Manager - Remote Work
description:
At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley. 




Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.




When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.




CRM Manager at BairesDev




In this role, you'll own CRM execution for BairesDev's VIP Audiences & Experiences function, building and automating outreach sequences for our highest-value relationships across existing clients, former clients, and top-tier event audiences. Using Claude as your primary AI tool daily, you'll combine CRM expertise with generative AI fluency and automation workflows to generate measurable sales pipeline. What You'll Do:




- Build and execute multi-touch outreach sequences across email, direct mail, and event follow-up for VIP account segments.

What we are looking for:




- 5+ years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, or outbound marketing.

- Hands-on experience with outreach automation platforms such as Apollo, Clay, Lemlist, Reply.io, or equivalent.

- Proficiency in a CRM platform such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or equivalent.

- STEM or quantitative degree in Engineering, Math, Statistics, Economics, Data Science, or Physics; strong non-STEM candidates with a demonstrable data or numbers track record also considered.

- Advanced proficiency in English.




Nice to have:




- Experience in B2B tech services, staffing, or nearshore companies.

- Experience marketing to C-suite or VP-level audiences.

- Background in marketing analytics, copywriting, or growth marketing.

- Proficiency in Google Sheets.




How we do make your work (and your life) easier:




- 100% remote work (from anywhere).

- Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred

- Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.

- Flexible hours: create your own schedule.

- Paid parental leaves, vacations, and holidays.

- Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.

- Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.




Apply now and become part of a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!

description:
Skeelo Ciudad de México, Ciudad de México, Mexico

Skeelo es una plataforma digital de lectura que conecta a las personas con e-books, audiolibros y minibooks en una experiencia accesible y personalizada. Desde 2019, utilizamos la tecnología como un medio para democratizar el acceso a la lectura y ampliar su impacto en el desarrollo de las personas.

Creemos que leer va más allá del ocio: es una herramienta poderosa para ampliar horizontes, fortalecer el pensamiento crítico e impulsar el desarrollo humano.

Estamos distribuidos y distribuidas en Brasil y en el mundo, impulsados por la innovación, la agilidad y el aprendizaje continuo, valorando la diversidad y transformando la lectura para adaptarla a la vida de las personas. Hacemos todo esto con transparencia en las relaciones, valentía para innovar, enfoque en alta performance, mirada constante en encantar a clientes y lectores, y entregas ágiles que marcan la diferencia.

Nuestro modelo de trabajo es remote first, aprovechando lo mejor del home office: autorresponsabilidad con autonomía. Sin embargo, también creemos en la conexión y en el intercambio que generan los encuentros presenciales; por eso, realizamos algunos encuentros en São Paulo – SP para fortalecer la conexión con los demás Skeelers. Pero tranquila/o, Skeelo siempre organiza todo por nosotros.

¡El equipo de Marketing necesita a alguien y queremos que seas parte de nuestro equipo!

Serás la persona responsable de los procesos, cronogramas e indicadores, transformando la planificación estratégica en campañas ejecutadas con calidad. Tu rol será impulsar el crecimiento de los canales actuales y generar los insights necesarios para apoyar a la región.

Planificar y ejecutar campañas recurrentes con socios B2B, incluyendo la elaboración de briefings, apoyo en la estrategia y estructuración de canales, además del seguimiento de las métricas de éxito de las iniciativas.

Coordinar la planificación y ejecución del lanzamiento de nuevos socios, gestionando playbooks, cronogramas, calendarios de campañas e hitos de entrega con una visión integral del proceso.

Actuar como punto de contacto para socios SMB, construyendo relaciones sólidas y de largo plazo con aliados estratégicos.

Crear y monitorear dashboards e informes de desempeño (métricas de growth, engagement y conversión), transformando los datos en decisiones estratégicas.

Conectar a las áreas internas (Producto, Comercial, Marketing y Branding) para garantizar la alineación y consistencia de las acciones con los socios.

Documentar procesos, asegurando la visibilidad de los proyectos y cronogramas de entrega mediante herramientas de gestión.

Contribuir al desarrollo de nuevas oportunidades de negocio, aportando inteligencia de mercado y análisis comparativos (benchmark), impulsando activamente el crecimiento del engagement a través de los socios, garantizando la recurrencia y una visión de mejora continua de las iniciativas.

Experiencia previa en Marketing B2B, alianzas estratégicas, canales, growth o marketing digital con enfoque en socios o clientes corporativos.

Experiencia con herramientas de CRM y gestión de proyectos (HubSpot, RD Station, Asana, ClickUp o equivalentes).

Capacidad para gestionar cronogramas de proyectos y lanzamientos de socios con autonomía y organización.

Comunicación proactiva y fluida con múltiples áreas.

Inglés y español avanzados, tanto para lectura y escritura como para conversación.

Y sería un gran plus si también cuentas con:

Experiencia en growth con enfoque B2B y/o gestión de canales con visión de expansión regional.

Experiencia en operaciones LATAM o proyectos de internacionalización, especialmente en la gestión de husos horarios y colaboración con equipos de cultura hispanohablante.

Familiaridad con el sector de Telecomunicaciones o empresas con una fuerte interfaz comercial y un ecosistema de socios.

Conocimiento de herramientas como Google Analytics, Power BI, Tableau o AppsFlyer.

Modelo de trabajo Remote First, con encuentros presenciales durante el año en São Paulo, con toda la logística cubierta por la empresa.

title: Senior Marketing Analyst | Channel Partner B2B
description:
Skeelo Ciudad de México, Ciudad de México, Mexico

Skeelo es una plataforma digital de lectura que conecta a las personas con e-books, audiolibros y minibooks en una experiencia accesible y personalizada. Desde 2019, utilizamos la tecnología como un medio para democratizar el acceso a la lectura y ampliar su impacto en el desarrollo de las personas.

Creemos que leer va más allá del ocio: es una herramienta poderosa para ampliar horizontes, fortalecer el pensamiento crítico e impulsar el desarrollo humano.

Estamos distribuidos y distribuidas en Brasil y en el mundo, impulsados por la innovación, la agilidad y el aprendizaje continuo, valorando la diversidad y transformando la lectura para adaptarla a la vida de las personas. Hacemos todo esto con transparencia en las relaciones, valentía para innovar, enfoque en alta performance, mirada constante en encantar a clientes y lectores, y entregas ágiles que marcan la diferencia.

Nuestro modelo de trabajo es remote first, aprovechando lo mejor del home office: autorresponsabilidad con autonomía. Sin embargo, también creemos en la conexión y en el intercambio que generan los encuentros presenciales; por eso, realizamos algunos encuentros en São Paulo – SP para fortalecer la conexión con los demás Skeelers. Pero tranquila/o, Skeelo siempre organiza todo por nosotros.

¡El equipo de Marketing necesita a alguien y queremos que seas parte de nuestro equipo!

¿Tu misión? Garantizar la excelencia operativa y el desempeño de las alianzas B2B de Skeelo. Serás la persona responsable de los procesos, cronogramas e indicadores, transformando la planificación estratégica en campañas ejecutadas con calidad. Tu rol será impulsar el crecimiento de los canales actuales y generar los insights necesarios para apoyar a la región.

Así será tu día a día en Skeelo:

Planificar y ejecutar campañas recurrentes con socios B2B, incluyendo la elaboración de briefings, apoyo en la estrategia y estructuración de canales, además del seguimiento de las métricas de éxito de las iniciativas.

Coordinar la planificación y ejecución del lanzamiento de nuevos socios, gestionando playbooks, cronogramas, calendarios de campañas e hitos de entrega con una visión integral del proceso.

Actuar como punto de contacto para socios SMB, construyendo relaciones sólidas y de largo plazo con aliados estratégicos.

Crear y monitorear dashboards e informes de desempeño (métricas de growth, engagement y conversión), transformando los datos en decisiones estratégicas.

Conectar a las áreas internas (Producto, Comercial, Marketing y Branding) para garantizar la alineación y consistencia de las acciones con los socios.

Documentar procesos, asegurando la visibilidad de los proyectos y cronogramas de entrega mediante herramientas de gestión.

Contribuir al desarrollo de nuevas oportunidades de negocio, aportando inteligencia de mercado y análisis comparativos (benchmark), impulsando activamente el crecimiento del engagement a través de los socios, garantizando la recurrencia y una visión de mejora continua de las iniciativas.

Para Esto, Necesitarás

Experiencia previa en Marketing B2B, alianzas estratégicas, canales, growth o marketing digital con enfoque en socios o clientes corporativos.

Experiencia con herramientas de CRM y gestión de proyectos (HubSpot, RD Station, Asana, ClickUp o equivalentes).

Capacidad para gestionar cronogramas de proyectos y lanzamientos de socios con autonomía y organización.

Comunicación proactiva y fluida con múltiples áreas.

Inglés y español avanzados, tanto para lectura y escritura como para conversación.

Y sería un gran plus si también cuentas con:

Experiencia en growth con enfoque B2B y/o gestión de canales con visión de expansión regional.

Experiencia en operaciones LATAM o proyectos de internacionalización, especialmente en la gestión de husos horarios y colaboración con equipos de cultura hispanohablante.

Familiaridad con el sector de Telecomunicaciones o empresas con una fuerte interfaz comercial y un ecosistema de socios.

Conocimiento de herramientas como Google Analytics, Power BI, Tableau o AppsFlyer.

¿Y los beneficios? Cuidamos muy bien de quienes construyen esta historia con nosotros

Modelo de trabajo Remote First, con encuentros presenciales durante el año en São Paulo, con toda la logística cubierta por la empresa.

Bono anual por encima del promedio del mercado.

Días festivos locales, respetando la cultura de cada país.

Horarios flexibles, con hasta 2 horas de flexibilidad al inicio o final del día.

Programas de desarrollo: Ruta de Carrera, Universidad Skeelo y reconocimientos internos.

Día libre durante el mes de tu cumpleaños.

Licencia de maternidad y paternidad según la legislación local.

title: CRM Manager - Remote Work
description:
At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley. 




Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.




When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.




CRM Manager at BairesDev




In this role, you'll own CRM execution for BairesDev's VIP Audiences & Experiences function, building and automating outreach sequences for our highest-value relationships across existing clients, former clients, and top-tier event audiences. Using Claude as your primary AI tool daily, you'll combine CRM expertise with generative AI fluency and automation workflows to generate measurable sales pipeline. This is an individual-contributor role reporting directly to the Director of VIP Audiences & Experiences, where your work translates directly into meetings booked, accounts expanded, and revenue influenced.




What You'll Do:




- Build and execute multi-touch outreach sequences across email, direct mail, and event follow-up for VIP account segments.

- Build and maintain AI-assisted automation workflows connecting outreach, CRM, and data enrichment tools.

- Use Claude as primary AI tool daily for outreach copy, contact research, account intelligence, and workflow logic.

- Track and report on pipeline outcomes including meetings booked, accounts expanded, and revenue influenced.

- Own data enrichment workflows, keeping VIP contact records accurate, current, and actionable.




What we are looking for:




- 5+ years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, or outbound marketing.

- In-house experience at a US-based B2B company; agency or contractor work does not qualify.

- B2B SaaS or tech services industry experience.

- Hands-on experience with outreach automation platforms such as Apollo, Clay, Lemlist, Reply.io, or equivalent.

- Daily, hands-on use of generative AI and LLM tools, with Claude strongly preferred; prompt engineering skills required.

- Experience with automation workflows using Zapier, n8n, or Make.com.

- Proficiency in a CRM platform such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or equivalent.

- STEM or quantitative degree in Engineering, Math, Statistics, Economics, Data Science, or Physics; strong non-STEM candidates with a demonstrable data or numbers track record also considered.

- Advanced proficiency in English.




Nice to have:




- Experience in B2B tech services, staffing, or nearshore companies.

- Experience marketing to C-suite or VP-level audiences.

- Background in marketing analytics, copywriting, or growth marketing.

- Proficiency in Google Sheets.




How we do make your work (and your life) easier:




- 100% remote work (from anywhere).

- Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred

- Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.

- Flexible hours: create your own schedule.

- Paid parental leaves, vacations, and holidays.

- Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.

- Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.




Apply now and become part of a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!

Company Description

Doka Group, a subsidiary of the Umdasch Group, is one of the world’s largest manufacturers and suppliers of formwork and scaffolding products and systems with more than 160 sales and logistics facilities in over 70 countries. From its headquarters in Austria, Doka’s heritage of innovation has positioned itself as a front-runner in creating disruptive technologies for the construction market, with an emphasis firmly placed on supporting the needs of its clients.

title: Director/a fraccional de Marketing y Demand Generation B2B
description:
Waves Acoustics · Vacante WAC-RH-MKT-2026-01

Dirección fraccional de Marketing y Demand Generation B2B, con IA aplicada

Remoto desde México · Cierre: 26 de noviembre de 2026, 23:59 h (CDMX)




Construye demanda. Demuestra resultados. Usa IA con criterio.




SOBRE WAVES ACOUSTICS

Waves Acoustics es una firma mexicana de ingeniería acústica. Diseñamos y desarrollamos soluciones para espacios y proyectos —aislamiento, acondicionamiento, mediciones, simulación, diagnóstico técnico e implementación— para arquitectos, desarrolladores, hoteles, restaurantes, oficinas corporativas, industria y vivienda.




LA MISIÓN

Construir el sistema de generación de demanda B2B de Waves: conectar audiencia, campañas, contenido, web, Sales y medición para producir oportunidades comerciales, cobros y aprendizaje sobre qué funciona.

Buscamos a una persona responsable de la estrategia y de su ejecución coordinada. No buscamos una agencia completa, un community manager ni a alguien que haga solo todas las tareas del área.




RESPONSABILIDADES

• Definir audiencias, ofertas y mensajes para los segmentos B2B de Waves, y priorizarlos con evidencia.

• Diseñar y ejecutar campañas orgánicas y, con presupuesto acordado, pagadas, que lleven a oportunidades comerciales.

• Conectar web, landings y formularios con el CRM y con Sales: criterios de lead, lead aceptado por Sales (SAL), handoff y seguimiento.

• Impulsar SEO y contenido orientados a demanda, no a volumen de publicaciones.

• Medir y atribuir con honestidad: tablero, cortes periódicos, aprendizajes y decisiones.

• Aplicar IA con criterio en investigación, segmentación, contenido, análisis y automatización, siempre con verificación humana.

• Coordinarte con Diego Garcés (Dirección General) y con Sales, y reportar avances y resultados.

• Coordinar apoyos puntuales, internos o proveedores, cuando el acuerdo lo contemple.




REQUISITOS ESENCIALES

• Experiencia demostrable en generación de demanda B2B: al menos un caso que puedas explicar de campaña a oportunidad y a resultado. Puede estar anonimizado.

• Experiencia práctica en conversión (ofertas, landings, formularios), SEO, CRM y medición.

• Trabajo coordinado con equipos comerciales: criterios de lead, handoff y seguimiento.

• Conocimiento práctico de IA aplicada a Marketing (ver abajo).

• Capacidad para explicar con claridad, por escrito y en conversación, qué hiciste, por qué y qué resultado obtuviste.

• Trabajar desde México, con disponibilidad compatible con una colaboración fraccional por entregables.




IA APLICADA: REQUISITO EXPLÍCITO

Queremos ver usos concretos de IA en investigación, segmentación, contenido, análisis o automatización. En tu solicitud cuéntanos:

• qué problema resolviste;

• qué herramienta o flujo usaste;

• cómo verificaste la salida (revisión humana, fuentes, pruebas);

• qué resultado obtuviste.

Saber escribir prompts o mencionar una herramienta no es suficiente. Tampoco buscamos una marca específica de herramienta.




DESEABLE

• Experiencia en servicios técnicos, ingeniería, arquitectura, construcción o venta consultiva con ciclos largos.

• Experiencia como consultor/a o dirección fraccional con varios clientes.

• Pauta B2B con control de presupuesto y medición por oportunidad, no solo por clic.

• Automatización de marketing y conexión entre herramientas.




NO PEDIMOS

Títulos de una universidad específica, un número arbitrario de años, experiencia previa en acústica, vivir en Monterrey, fotografía ni datos personales que no ayuden a evaluar tu experiencia.




MODALIDAD Y DEDICACIÓN

• Dirección fraccional por servicios y entregables, sujeta a formalización acorde con la operación real.

• Remota desde México, con opción híbrida mediante reuniones previamente acordadas. No necesitas vivir en Monterrey.

• Tú propones tu disponibilidad; acordamos entregables y capacidad. No es jornada completa ni pide exclusividad.

• Colaboración directa con Diego Garcés y coordinación con Sales.




COMPENSACIÓN (LÉELA COMPLETA ANTES DE POSTULARTE)

La etapa inicial no tiene base garantizada.




Qué es UBC: cobro neto sin IVA menos los costos directos correspondientes, asignados y validados. El variable se calcula sobre UBC positiva elegible, atribuible a Marketing y liberada por Finance. Facturar no equivale a cobrar, e influir en una venta no basta para originar comisión.




Etapa 1 · Validación (inicio de la colaboración)

• Base: $0

• Variable: 5% de UBC elegible

• Bono: $100 por lead aceptado por Sales (SAL)

• Bono: $250 por reunión elegible celebrada

• Tope conjunto de ambos bonos: $1,500 MXN al mes

• Si en un mes no hay hitos elegibles ni UBC liquidable, el pago de ese mes puede ser $0.




Etapas posteriores propuestas (no son ascensos automáticos; requieren resultados sostenidos y acuerdo escrito)

• Etapa 2 · Consistencia: $6,000 mensuales + 4% de UBC elegible, sin los bonos de la etapa 1. Referencia de acceso: promedio mensual, en tres meses consecutivos, de $150,000 de UBC atribuible y 12 SAL.

• Etapa 3 · Escala: $10,000 mensuales + 4% de UBC elegible + 0.5% únicamente sobre el excedente mensual de $500,000, sin los bonos de la etapa 1. Referencia de acceso: promedio mensual, en tres meses consecutivos, de $300,000 de UBC atribuible y 18 SAL.




Ejemplos ilustrativos (no son ingresos garantizados)

• Etapa 1 con $130,000 de UBC elegible en el mes: 5% = $6,500; con los bonos en su tope, $8,000.

• Etapa 3 con $520,000 de UBC: $10,000 + $20,800 (4%) + $100 (0.5% de los $20,000 excedentes) = $30,900. No se aplica 4.5% al total.

• Con el bono máximo, las etapas 1 y 2 pagan lo mismo con $450,000 de UBC; por encima de esa cifra, la etapa 2 paga menos. Lo revisamos contigo en la conversación económica.




Las reglas de SAL, reuniones, deduplicación y atribución se formalizan por escrito antes de iniciar. Importes en pesos mexicanos (MXN), antes de impuestos aplicables al acuerdo. Waves cubre la publicidad con presupuesto acordado; la persona no la financia. No se ofrecen acciones, sociedad ni prestaciones.




QUÉ COMPARTIR EN TU SOLICITUD

• Un caso de generación de demanda B2B: audiencia, problema, qué hiciste, inversión si aplica, resultado y cómo lo mediste y atribuiste.

• Un ejemplo de IA aplicada: problema, herramienta o flujo, verificación humana y resultado.

• Tu enfoque para los primeros 90 días.

• Tu disponibilidad propuesta, ciudad y país.

• Opcional: enlaces a tu perfil o CV.

Puedes anonimizar tus casos. No envíes secretos comerciales ni información confidencial de clientes.




PROCESO DE SELECCIÓN

1. Solicitud en el formulario oficial, antes del cierre.

2. Revisión humana de cada solicitud: buscamos un ejemplo pertinente de demanda B2B, una aplicación concreta de IA y disponibilidad y modalidad compatibles. Si falta algo, podemos pedirte una aclaración; una respuesta incompleta no se descarta de forma automática.

3. Conversación inicial.

4. Revisión a fondo de un caso.

5. Conversación final.

6. Decisión: acordar la colaboración por escrito o continuar la búsqueda.

Algunas conversaciones pueden empezar antes del cierre. La recepción sigue abierta hasta la fecha publicada.




CÓMO POSTULARTE

Solicitud y condiciones completas: https://wavesacoustics.com/talento/marketing-demand-generation/?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=job_listing&utm_campaign=rh_marketing_2026

Cierre: 26 de noviembre de 2026, 23:59 h (CDMX).

Postularse no tiene costo. No necesitas seguir nuestras cuentas, compartir publicaciones ni suscribirte a publicidad para participar.

Contacto: d.garces@wavesacoustics.com

description:
About Manukora

Manukora is a global wellness brand, leading the fast-growing US Mānuka honey category. We're on a mission to preserve the power of Mānuka and deliver it to the world in pure, functional formats at uncompromising quality, purity and potency.




Born in the wilds of New Zealand, we harvest one of the planet's rarest natural resources: raw Mānuka honey. This creamy caramel super honey contains unique antioxidants, prebiotics, and a special antibacterial compound called "MGO."




Established in 2015, we are a founder-led, family-owned business headquartered in New Zealand with operations globally in the United States and Europe. Manukora is a certified B Corporation, working with locally-based master beekeeping partners to produce the highest quality Mānuka, leading through ethical beekeeping practices and investing in our bees, their environment and the communities that surround them.




We are a team of beekeepers, herbalists, food scientists, and wellness professionals working to deliver this one-of-a-kind honey and reimagine the immune and digestive wellness categories.




The role

We're bringing our paid ad creative in-house, and this is the hire that makes it happen. You'll be the dedicated designer for our paid team: statics and light motion for Meta, Amazon and our landing pages, briefed by our US-based creative strategists and built to one visual standard across brand and performance. You'll report to our Senior Design Lead for design craft, brand standards and development, and work with the strategists and paid creative team day to day.




You'll take over the paid static and motion work an external agency does for us today, at the same volume and standard from your first month. This is not a role with a learning curve on the basics.This is a performance designer role, not a brand designer who happens to make ads. You think in hooks, hierarchy and thumb-stop on a phone screen. You're happy making 20 variants of a winner, and you want to know why version C beat version A. But you're brand-fluent enough to hold a premium standard - no meme ads, no two visual worlds.




What you'll do

Paid statics - design static ad concepts for Meta feed, TikTok, YouTube and other ad placements from creative strategist briefs, plus Amazon A+ content and landing page heroes
Light motion - bring statics to life with subtle animation: short, looping, ~5-second assets, not full video edits
Rapid iteration - most of the work is variants of what's already winning. Turn around fast, clean variant sets on new hooks, headlines, visuals and formats
Own the paid template system - build and maintain a documented static system (formats, sizes, brand-safe layouts, claim placements) that makes speed and consistency the default
Get it right on-canvas - apply our claims and compliance rules (MGO grades, product claims) and brand guidelines to every asset, every time
Read your own results - go into Motion, see how your ads performed, and work with the strategists on why - then design the next round off that
Deliver to spec and deadline - work through the production queue with the creative strategists, Creative Producer & Ops, and the growth/paid team
When there's capacity, support the wider design team on landing pages, retail and other digital assets




What you'll bring

5+ years designing paid social creative for US, UK or Australian DTC or CPG brands, in-house or at an agency, running high volumes of paid ads
A portfolio of ads that actually ran, ideally with results or context on what worked. A portfolio link is required, and it must include paid social ads that ran. Applications showing only brand, packaging or organic work will not be reviewed.
A strong understanding of how paid ads work - hooks, formats, placements, creative testing, and what moves the numbers
Excellent hierarchy, typography and layout instincts at thumbnail size
Fluency in Figma, plus After Effects or similar motion
Comfort with AI tools in the workflow (we use Higgsfield and CapCut) - used with judgement, never at the expense of craft
Speed without sloppiness - you can hit a volume target and still care about every pixel
Brand-standard discipline - you respect a guideline and know how to push inside it
At least 4 hours a day overlapping with 9am to 5pm Pacific, Monday to Friday, to work live with our US-based creative strategists




What this role is not

Long-form video editing
Packaging or brand campaign concepting
Organic social
Junior/entry-level - you should be able to take a brief and run
A role where we'll teach you paid creative. We need you producing to brief, at our standard, within your first two weeks
A slow-paced role. We're a high-volume, fast-scaling business and the work needs focus




What success looks like in your first 90 days

All paid statics and light motion made in-house, at or above our current weekly volume
A documented static template system the whole team can work from
Your static win rate tracked against our current baseline




Why you'll love it

Your work ships weekly - you'll see what you made go live, and see exactly how it performed
A brand worth designing for - premium product, distinctive identity, and an audience that genuinely loves what we make. A chance to work with a leading US wellness brand.
One team, one standard - you'll sit in the design team (4 other global team members), close to the brand, with the paid team as your daily connect
Fully remote - at least 4 hours' overlap with 9am to 5pm Pacific




How to apply

Email marlen@manukora.com with the subject line “Performance Designer - Paid Creative - [Your Name]” and include your CV, your portfolio link (it must include paid social ads that actually ran), and short answers to these 2 questions:

Which US, UK or Australian DTC/consumer brands have you designed paid social ads for? For each one, tell us roughly how long you worked on it and whether it was in-house, at an agency or freelance.
Share one ad you designed that performed well, and the numbers behind it (for example, cost per purchase, ROAS or how it did against other ads).




Important: applications that don’t answer both questions won’t be considered.

description:
Description

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Meta Ads Specialist to join our Lead Generation Department at Practice360.

This role focuses on developing, managing, and optimizing Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns for multiple client accounts, primarily within the legal and professional services industries.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience managing Meta advertising budgets of at least $10,000 USD per month, a strong understanding of lead generation strategies, and the ability to analyze campaign performance to consistently improve results.

Our department focuses on generating qualified leads that convert into booked consultations and signed clients. We are looking for someone who understands that successful advertising goes beyond generating leads. The ultimate goal is to deliver high-quality opportunities that drive measurable results for our clients.

Key Responsibilities


Campaign Strategy & Management
Develop, launch, manage, and optimize Meta advertising campaigns across Facebook and Instagram for multiple client accounts.
Create lead generation strategies tailored to each client's target audience, practice area, budget, and business objectives.
Manage daily and monthly advertising budgets to ensure effective spending and consistent lead generation.
Build and manage campaigns using Meta Ads Manager, including campaign structures, targeting, placements, budgets, and optimization settings.
Identify opportunities to increase lead volume, improve lead quality, and reduce acquisition costs.
Stay current with Meta advertising updates, policies, and best practices.
Lead Generation & Optimization
Create and optimize Meta Instant Forms with custom screening and qualifying questions to improve lead quality.
Develop and execute A/B testing strategies for ad creatives, headlines, primary text, audiences, and lead forms.
Analyze campaign performance to identify winning creatives and opportunities for improvement.
Monitor lead quality and conversion performance to ensure campaigns generate valuable opportunities for clients.
Troubleshoot underperforming campaigns and proactively implement changes to improve results.
Use Meta Ads Library to research competitor advertising strategies and identify new creative opportunities.
Performance Monitoring & Reporting
Monitor advertising campaigns daily and make data-driven optimizations.
Analyze key performance indicators, including:
Spend
Leads Generated
Cost Per Lead (CPL)
Qualified Leads
Booked Consultations
Cost Per Booked Consultation
Signed Clients / Retainers
Cost Per Acquisition (CPA/CAC)
Analyze advertising performance beyond Meta Ads Manager by reviewing lead quality and client conversion data.
Identify performance issues early and communicate recommendations to the Lead Generation Manager.
Tracking & Lead Delivery
Ensure Meta lead forms and tracking systems are properly configured and functioning.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure leads are accurately delivered to clients through email, CRM integrations, or automated workflows.
Assist with troubleshooting tracking discrepancies, lead delivery issues, and campaign-related technical problems.
Maintain organized campaign structures, naming conventions, and accurate performance records.
Creative Development & Collaboration
Collaborate with graphic designers and content creators to develop high-performing static advertisements and video creatives.
Provide clear creative briefs, including headlines, messaging, target audiences, and calls to action.
Regularly recommend new advertising concepts based on campaign results, competitor research, and audience behavior.
Work closely with Account Managers and the Lead Generation Manager to review client performance, lead quality, and campaign goals.
Proactively communicate campaign updates, challenges, and optimization opportunities.


Requirements


Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience managing Meta advertising campaigns.
Experience managing at least $10,000 USD in monthly Meta advertising spend.
Proven experience running lead generation campaigns, not just engagement, traffic, or brand awareness campaigns.
Strong proficiency in Meta Ads Manager, Meta Business Suite, and Meta Ads Library.
Experience creating and optimizing Meta Instant Forms.
Strong understanding of campaign structure, audience targeting, creative testing, and conversion optimization.
Ability to analyze advertising data and make informed decisions to improve campaign performance.
Experience managing multiple campaigns or client accounts simultaneously.
Strong understanding of CPL, CPA, conversion rates, and advertising budget management.
Excellent organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Willingness to work in US time zones (PST, EST, CST). 
High school diploma or equivalent.


Preferred


Experience managing Meta advertising campaigns for law firms or professional service businesses.
Previous experience working in a digital marketing agency or lead generation agency.
Familiarity with HubSpot, Zapier, Google Sheets, or other CRM and lead management platforms.
Knowledge of Meta Pixel, Conversions API, and conversion tracking.
Experience collaborating with creative teams to develop performance-driven advertisements.
Familiarity with Meta advertising policies, particularly those involving legal services and sensitive advertising topics.


Soft Skills


Results-Oriented: Focuses on generating qualified leads and measurable client acquisition results.
Proactive: Identifies performance issues and recommends solutions without waiting for direction.
Analytical: Uses campaign data to guide decisions rather than relying on assumptions.
Organized: Can effectively manage multiple client accounts, budgets, campaigns, and deadlines.
Strong Communicator: Clearly explains campaign performance, challenges, and recommendations to internal teams.
Creative Thinker: Consistently brings new advertising ideas, testing strategies, and optimization opportunities.
Adaptable: Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities and campaign requirements may change.

description:

Previous experience in the pet industry would be an additional advantage.
