title: Brand Marketing Manager
description:
SKEELO: EMBÁRCATE EN LA JORNADA QUE PONE LA LECTURA EN EL CENTRO DE TODO.

QUIÉNES SOMOS

Skeelo es una plataforma digital de lectura que conecta a las personas con e-books, audiolibros y minibooks en una experiencia accesible y personalizada. Desde 2019, utilizamos la tecnología como un medio para democratizar el acceso a la lectura y ampliar su impacto en el desarrollo de las personas.

Creemos que leer va más allá del ocio: es una herramienta poderosa para ampliar horizontes, fortalecer el pensamiento crítico e impulsar el desarrollo humano.

NUESTRA VIBE

Estamos distribuidos y distribuidas en Brasil y en el mundo, impulsados por la innovación, la agilidad y el aprendizaje continuo, valorando la diversidad y transformando la lectura para adaptarla a la vida de las personas. Hacemos todo esto con transparencia en las relaciones, valentía para innovar, enfoque en alta performance, mirada constante en encantar a clientes y lectores, y entregas ágiles que marcan la diferencia.

Nuestro modelo de trabajo es remote first, aprovechando lo mejor del home office: autorresponsabilidad con autonomía. Sin embargo, también creemos en la conexión y en el intercambio que generan los encuentros presenciales; por eso, realizamos algunos encuentros en São Paulo – SP para fortalecer la conexión con los demás Skeelers. Pero tranquila/o, Skeelo siempre organiza todo por nosotros.

¡El equipo de Marketing de Skeelo está creciendo y queremos que seas parte de él!

¿Tu misión?

Liderar el marketing de Skeelo en México: con mentalidad de negocio, entender el mercado, convertir oportunidades en un brand plan y movilizar a las áreas internas para ejecutarlo. Un rol 100% local, de alta visibilidad y con camino hacia el liderazgo de marketing en el país.

Tu día a día en Skeelo será así

Estrategia de marca

Construir y ser dueño/a del brand plan de México: diagnóstico, posicionamiento, público, mensajes, KPIs e inversión.

Adaptar la estrategia de marca al consumidor mexicano, manteniendo la consistencia global.

Responder por los KPIs de salud de marca (awareness, consideración, share of voice) y de engagement.

Agencias y áreas internas

Liderar a las agencias (creativa, medios, social): briefs claros, feedback creativo, aprobación de piezas y gestión de alcance y presupuesto.

Orientar y alinear a Growth, CRM, Contenido, PR, Producto, B2B y Social Media, movilizándolos sin autoridad formal.

Trabajar con Contenido para convertir títulos y narrativas en campañas y conversación de marca.

Calendario y resultados

Liderar el calendario de campañas 360° de México, con trade-offs explícitos cuando la demanda supere la capacidad.

Medir, reportar y ajustar la inversión según desempeño, con recomendaciones para el liderazgo de Marketing y LATAM.

Cómo trabajamos

Usamos IA como parte central de nuestro flujo de trabajo.

Nos importa genuinamente el bienestar de cada persona del equipo.

Para esto, vas a necesitar tener

Experiencia sólida como Brand Manager, con responsabilidad sobre KPIs de marca y engagement.

Haber construido y ejecutado un brand plan de punta a punta, con resultados medibles.

Experiencia liderando agencias y coordinando campañas 360° con múltiples áreas.

Dominio de métricas de marca, presupuesto y desempeño.

Conocimiento profundo del consumidor mexicano.

Español nivel nativo e inglés fluido.

Disponibilidad para trabajar desde Ciudad de México.

Y sería muy bueno si también tuvieras

Portugués.

Experiencia en entretenimiento, editoriales, streaming o contenido digital.

Experiencia con distribución vía socios (telecom, bancos, retail).

Red de contactos en agencias, medios y entretenimiento en México.

Plano de saúde (sem custo e sem coparticipação para você e seus familiares) + odonto e seguro de vida

VA/VR flexível no Caju (liberdade real de uso)

Parceria com escolas de idiomas, Berlitz e Open English

Feriados de SP emendados + recesso remunerado no fim do ano

Day off de aniversário

Bono anual por encima del promedio del mercado.

description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Director, CA&E Products

About The Job

Our Purpose

We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation and delivers better business results.

Job Title

Director – Consumer Acquisition and Engagement, Product

Overview

Mastercard’s Services organization is a key growth engine, delivering innovative solutions that help our customers thrive. By integrating proprietary data, cutting-edge technology, expert insights, and strategic expertise, Services plays a critical role in driving Mastercard’s differentiation and business growth. We work side by side with our clients as a key lever to help grow their business through innovative, scalable, and technology-enabled solutions.

Within the Services organization, Consumer Acquisition & Engagement places Mastercard at the heart of our customers’ B2C and B2B lifecycle management strategies. We help our customers acquire, engage, and retain consumers through end-to-end services, platforms, and marketing solutions.

Role

The Consumer Acquisition & Engagement (CA&E) team focuses on products and solutions that address dynamic market needs. We are seeking a Regional Director – CA&E Products for North LAC to lead the go-to-market strategy, commercialization agenda, market expansion of innovative Loyalty solutions and drive Offers across the division.

This role will shape regional growth by identifying market opportunities, defining differentiated product narratives, and enabling sales teams with scalable commercialization strategies. The Director will serve as a senior strategic partner across regional and global product, sales, account management, and market teams to accelerate adoption and business impact.

The ideal candidate brings broad experience across digital marketing, media strategy, and media agency engagement, with strong expertise in integrated campaign planning, audience strategy, performance measurement, and commercialization. This individual should be equally comfortable driving executive-level strategy, influencing cross-functional stakeholders, and translating market and client needs into compelling growth opportunities.

Key Responsibilities


 Drive regional growth by leading the commercialization strategy for CA&E solutions across North LAC, with a focus on Marketing, Personalization, and data-driven customer engagement capabilities.
 Define and execute differentiated go-to-market strategies that reflect market maturity, customer priorities, competitive dynamics, and regional business opportunities.
 Act as the regional subject matter expert on media, digital marketing, and customer engagement trends, including media planning, audience targeting, campaign orchestration, and performance optimization.
 Bring strong experience working with media agencies and partners, with the ability to assess media strategies, challenge plans constructively, and connect media investments to business outcomes.
 Develop compelling product narratives, value propositions, and sales enablement materials tailored to different customer segments, industries, and market contexts.
 Partner closely with Sales, Account Management, and Product teams to support strategic client engagements, commercial proposals, and high-impact RFP responses.
 Lead scalable 1:M commercialization initiatives, including regional campaigns, thought leadership, training, and tools that expand awareness and accelerate pipeline generation.
 Translate client, market, and competitive insights into recommendations that influence product evolution, roadmap prioritization, and regional growth strategy.
 Establish clear success metrics and measurement frameworks to evaluate commercialization effectiveness, campaign performance, and business impact.
 Influence and align cross-functional, matrixed teams across regional and global stakeholders, driving clarity, focus, and execution excellence.



All About You


 +10 years’ experience in product marketing, media, marketing strategy, or related roles, with a strong track record of driving growth in complex and dynamic markets.
 Broad experience in media and media agencies, including exposure to integrated media planning, performance marketing, audience strategy, measurement, and agency collaboration models.
 Strong business acumen and strategic thinking, with the ability to connect customer needs, market dynamics, and commercial opportunities into actionable growth plans.
 Demonstrated success leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing senior stakeholders within highly matrixed, international organizations.
 Deep knowledge of digital marketing, loyalty, consumer engagement, and personalization, with the ability to translate technical or platform capabilities into client value.
 Experience developing go-to-market strategies, sales enablement programs, and customer-facing narratives that support adoption and commercialization at scale.
 Strong analytical and data-driven mindset, with comfort interpreting performance signals, market intelligence, and business metrics to guide decisions.
 Exceptional storytelling, communication, and executive presence, with the ability to influence, inspire, and simplify complex concepts for varied audiences.
 Creative, proactive, and solution-oriented, with the ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, evolving environments.
 International and regional experience within matrixed organizations is highly desirable.



Corporate Security Responsibility

 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:


Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Working in close collaboration with the Marketing Communication / Branding and Digital Communication Centers of Excellence plus Global Category Leads and regional commercial / marketing teams, this global position will develop the sales enablement tools and training needed to be successful in the market.

description:
AI Product Builder Improvado is an AI-powered, unified platform designed for marketing teams in medium to large-scale enterprises and agencies, who are looking to automate complex marketing intelligence and reporting to make decisions with ease.

Improvado gathers, organizes, and untangles marketing data to deliver instant insights through BI and AI, helping to eliminate complexity, delivering laser-focused insights to optimize budgets, enhance campaign efficiency and marketing ROI.

About the role As an AI Product Builder you own one product area end to end.

Which area depends on where we need you most, and the work is the same in all of them.

Our products turn marketing data into decisions, and each of them has the same failure mode: it tells the customer something and stops there.

Your job is to find where your area stops short of causing a decision, build the part that closes that gap, and show that somebody acted.

You will build hands-on with AI, shape the roadmap, work directly with engineering teams and with customers, and decide what a good recommendation looks like for a different persona on the same data - a media buyer, an analyst and a CMO do not want the same thing.

About Hilbert

Hilbert is a scalable, data science-first growth engine that gives B2C teams predictive clarity into user behavior, revenue drivers, and the actions that drive sustainable growth. Fully agentic by design, Hilbert shrinks months-long decision cycles to minutes.

From Fortune 10 enterprises to beloved brands like FreshDirect, Blank Street, and Levain Bakery, operators run their growth on Hilbert. We're also co-building alongside leading AI companies.

The problem you are hired to solve

Hilbert's pipeline comes from Executive dinners, advisor firesides at the office, briefings at the customer's offices, side events at conferences. Events and warm introductions produce most of the deals that reach a second meeting.

Today those rooms happen when a founder or a regional sales leader makes them happen. There is no calendar, no owner, no follow-up standard and no count of which room produced which meeting. The Americas pipeline spans the United States, Mexico, Brazil and the Andean markets, and the sellers in each of them are building their own event plans from scratch.

That is this role: own the Americas event programme end to end, decide what goes on it, and measure it on the budget-holder meetings it produces.

What the role is

The Field Marketing Manager owns the strategy and the execution of every in-person and live-audience programme in the Americas. The job has two halves.

The first is the outside calendar: which conferences and industry events Hilbert joins, at what level, and what it does there. You recommend the list with the reasoning, and then you run each one, from the sponsorship decision to the side event, the speaker slots, the meeting schedule and the on-site execution.

The second is the programmes Hilbert hosts itself: executive dinners in the hub cities, advisor and investor firesides and podcast recordings at the office, customer roundtables and webinars. You design the format, the audience and the guest list, propose it, and then produce every part of it, including the promotion and the follow-up that turn attendance into meetings.

You plan both halves with the regional sales leaders, run them yourself, and report what each one produced. You are the first field marketer in the Americas. Your counterpart in EMEA runs the same programme there, and you build the shared playbook together.

What the role is not


Not content production. The founders and the product marketing lead decide what Hilbert says publicly and write the materials. You decide where it is said, to whom, and what happens the next morning.
Not paid acquisition. Hilbert runs no paid demand programmes today and this role does not start one.


The impact you will have


Decide the Americas calendar for the year with the regional sales leaders: which outside events to join, which events to host and in which office cities, which accounts in the room, and what each one has to produce. Recommend it with the reasoning and own it once agreed.
Run the executive dinner series in the hub cities, with guest lists drawn from target accounts and late-stage deals, and a follow-up plan agreed with the sellers before the invitations go out.
Own Hilbert's presence at the conferences you chose, from the sponsorship decision to the side event, the speaker slots, the meeting schedule and the on-site execution.
Design and produce the office programmes: advisor and investor firesides, live-audience podcast recordings, customer roundtables and webinars. You propose the format and the guest, and then you produce the whole thing, from the invitation to the recording to what is published afterwards.
Run pre-event targeting and post-event follow-up with sellers so that attendance becomes meetings within the week, not the quarter.
Manage vendors, venues, budgets and the partners who co-host with Hilbert.
Promote every programme through the channels Hilbert uses, LinkedIn and the newsletter among them, within the review process the company sets for public content.
Track every programme in the CRM: invited, attended, met, advanced. Report it monthly and change the calendar on what the numbers say.
Write the playbook, so that a dinner in Mexico City runs to the same standard as one in New York, and so that the next region can copy it.


How you are measured


Meetings with budget holders at target accounts that trace to a programme you ran.
Late-stage deals that advanced within thirty days of an event their buyer attended.
Cost per qualified meeting, by format.
Programmes delivered on the date and budget agreed.


What we look for


Four or more years in field marketing or event marketing at a B2B technology company with an enterprise sales motion, with end-to-end ownership of programmes from guest list to follow-up.
Has built an event strategy, not only executed one. Can show a calendar they designed, what they chose to join, what they chose to host, what they turned down, and what each produced.
Has run executive dinners and small, senior rooms and can show which meetings and deals came out of them. Has also run a conference presence with speakers, side events and a meeting schedule.
Has designed and produced an owned format from nothing: a dinner series, a podcast, a fireside or a webinar programme that ran more than once because it worked.
Works as a partner to sellers: plans the room with them, holds them to the follow-up, and is trusted with the account list.
Operationally exact. Vendors, venues, budgets, registration, name badges and the follow-up list are all yours, and you keep every one of them on track.
Writes a clear invitation, a clear brief for a speaker and a clear report for a sales leader.
Fluent in English and Spanish. The Americas programme runs in both.
Comfortable at startup pace, with a programme to build, no agency behind you at first, and a founder's calendar to work around.
Able to travel around 30 percent across the United States and Latin America.


Nice to have: Portuguese; experience with HubSpot; a network among CMOs and growth leaders in retail, grocery, QSR or banking; experience at a company that sold to the same buyers Hilbert sells to; experience building a field programme from nothing.

Your first ninety days


Weeks 1 to 3. Meet every seller in the Americas and read the pipeline. Audit the events run so far and what they produced. Take over the next dinner already on the calendar.
Weeks 4 to 8. Recommend the Americas calendar through the next two quarters: the outside events to join, the programmes to host, and why. Run two programmes end to end, with follow-up tracked in the CRM.
Weeks 9 to 12. Report the first ninety days by format and cost per meeting. Agree the shared playbook with your EMEA counterpart. Tell us which formats to drop.


You will inherit a brand system, a target-account list, an advisor network that opens doors and a track record of dinners that worked. You will not inherit a calendar or a team. Both are deliberate.

Reporting and location


Reports to the Head of GTM Strategy and Operations. Works daily with the regional sales leaders for North America and Latin America, the product marketing lead and the founders.
Based in San Francisco, New York or Mexico City, hybrid. Travel around 30 percent.


Why join us

At Hilbert, we move fast, work collaboratively, and give people real ownership over their impact. As a fast-growing company, there's no shortage of room to grow — you'll take on new challenges quickly and shape the path as you go.

Hilbert is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive culture, and we welcome applicants of all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Job Description

The Client Insights & Delivery (CID) Analyst is a foundational role within the Global Nielsen Campaign Analytics team, focused on delivering actionable recommendations that drive client success and market impact.

As a member of this fast-paced, client-facing team, your primary responsibility is to work directly with media companies and advertisers to understand campaign objectives, advise on study setup, and provide performance analysis. PMG, a global independent platform company engineered for impact, integrates business strategy, media, creative, and data within a single operating model powered by our proprietary operating system, Alli. With more than 1,000 employees, PMG partners with brands including Apple, Nike, Dropbox, Experian, Sephora, and Whole Foods. Our work has earned top industry honors, including Cannes Lions and Adweek’s Media Plan of the Year, and PMG has won 40+ workplace culture awards, including being the only company to rank among Ad Age’s Best Places to Work for 11 consecutive years.

Who You Will Be Working With

At PMG, our Analytics team is at the heart of turning data into insights that fuel smarter marketing, media, and business decisions. We go beyond surface-level metrics to help teams understand performance, improve measurement, and ensure the data and tools behind those decisions are accurate, reliable, and actionable.

You’ll collaborate with media strategists, analytics leaders, data engineers, data scientists, and client teams to support the analytics data, reporting, measurement workflows, and technology that power our work. You’ll also work closely with PMG’s Alli platform, helping ensure its analytics capabilities and underlying data remain accurate, reliable, and usable for both internal teams and customers.

As an Analytics Senior Associate, you’ll have the opportunity to strengthen your technical and analytical skills while solving real-world marketing challenges. From maintaining dashboards and analytics logic to troubleshooting data issues and supporting measurement initiatives, your work will help teams confidently use data to make better decisions.

What You Will Be Doing


Support internal teams and customers by ensuring analytics data, reporting, measurement workflows, and Alli platform capabilities remain accurate, reliable, and usable. 
Build, maintain, and improve analytics logic, dashboards, reports, trackers, taxonomy, automation, workflows, and platform capabilities. 
Support the development and maintenance of analytics solutions across data sourcing, transformation, validation, and visualization. 
Build and maintain dbt tests and other data-quality checks to identify issues and improve the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of analytics data. 
Monitor data sources and resolve freshness, quality, and availability issues, including completing backfills and reloads when needed. 
Investigate and troubleshoot reporting, data, platform, and performance issues, remediate alerts, and coordinate with the appropriate teams to drive resolution. 
Prepare and deliver accurate data for marketing measurement initiatives, including media mix modeling (MMM), LiftLab, lift studies, and other measurement workflows. 
Create and maintain clear media reporting that connects campaign performance to customer actions and business KPIs. 
Support Alli platform upgrades, enhancements, testing, and ongoing analytics capabilities. 
Partner with cross-functional teams, including Media, Client Strategy, Data Science, and Engineering, to support measurement strategies and analytics solutions aligned with customer objectives. 
Coordinate with stakeholders through consultation, documentation, onboarding, training, and ongoing support to improve adoption and usability of analytics tools and workflows. 
Identify opportunities to improve and automate recurring analytics processes, reporting, and data workflows. 
Stay current on marketing measurement, analytics tools, data practices, and emerging technologies, including AI and automation. 


What You Will Bring


1–3 years of experience in analytics, data analytics, marketing analytics, business intelligence, or a related field, with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience. 
Experience working with SQL to query, transform, validate, and analyze data. 
Familiarity with data warehousing platforms such as Amazon Redshift, BigQuery, or Snowflake. 
Experience with or exposure to data transformation and workflow tools such as dbt, including data-quality testing and validation. 
Experience building or maintaining dashboards and reports using visualization platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker. 
Familiarity with digital marketing, media, or advertising data and an interest in understanding how data supports marketing decision-making. 
Exposure to marketing measurement concepts such as media mix modeling, lift testing, incrementality testing, attribution, or experimentation. 
Ability to investigate data discrepancies, troubleshoot reporting issues, and work across teams to identify and resolve root causes. 
Strong attention to detail and a proactive approach to maintaining data quality, consistency, and accuracy. 
Ability to manage multiple requests and priorities while delivering accurate, high-quality work in a fast-paced environment. 
Strong communication skills with the ability to document processes, explain analytical concepts, and provide support to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
Familiarity with Python or R for analysis, automation, or data workflows is a plus. 
Experience with ETL/ELT pipelines, workflow automation, taxonomy management, or data quality monitoring is a plus. 
Experience working with marketing technology, ad tech, data clean rooms, or measurement platforms is a plus. 
A commitment to curiosity and adaptability as a Continual Learner, staying at the forefront of media innovation while prioritizing client success with a Customer-Focused mindset that seeks opportunities to deliver meaningful value. 
A People-Focused approach to collaboration, building strong relationships across teams and contributing to an environment where others can succeed. 


What We Offer

Performance-Based Rewards: Your impact should be part of your reward. This role is eligible for PMG’s annual bonus program—a standout part of our total compensation offering and an opportunity to share in our success. Bonus awards are informed by individual impact and performance, as well as team and company results, and are subject to applicable program terms.

Professional Development: Keep growing through learning and development programs, mentorship opportunities, and support for career advancement.

Generous Time Off: Take the time you need to recharge, connect with loved ones, and enjoy life outside work.

Parental Leave: Receive paid parental leave during life’s important family moments.

Retirement Benefits: Build for your future with competitive retirement benefits, including employer contributions or matching where applicable.

Fertility and Family Support: Access fertility and family-building benefits for eligible employees and their spouses or partners.

Healthcare: Choose from medical, dental, and vision coverage designed to support you and your family.

Pet Insurance: Access optional coverage for the four-legged members of your family.

Lifestyle Spending Account: Receive company-funded support for eligible health and well-being expenses.

Commuter Benefits: Access support for your commute where available.

Volunteering Opportunities: Receive eight paid hours each year to give back to your community.

AI Tools and Training: Access enterprise AI tools and ongoing training that helps PMGers use AI effectively, creatively, and responsibly.

Our benefits and compensation programs may vary by location and eligibility and are subject to applicable plan terms. We’ll share full details during the hiring process.

What Sets Us Apart

Being part of PMG means joining a company culture that’s unmatched in digital. We're dedicated to working hard to serve our employees and clients, delivering value, results, and innovation—which often requires true grit and agility. We believe in taking care of ourselves and each other to continuously improve in every way.

In alignment with our core values to be inclusive and always change for the better, PMG is committed to creating a more diverse and inclusive culture, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe that we only change for the better by bringing diverse perspectives to our company. PMG recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

skills: Implementación de Tagging: Configurar etiquetas, variables y disparadores (triggers) principalmente en Google Tag Manager (GTM) tanto web como server-side, bajo la guía del Manager, así como en otras herramientas de tagging como Adobe Target, Quantum Metric, Appsflyer y Tealium.

Aseguramiento de Calidad (QA): Realizar pruebas de validación e inspección técnica para verificar que los scripts, dataLayers y eventos registren datos de manera precisa.

Colaboración: Participar activamente en las sesiones de alineación interna del equipo técnico para compartir avances y aprender de las soluciones aplicadas en otras cuentas.
Precisión en configuraciones de código y etiquetado.
Habilidad para expresar dudas técnicas, pedir ayuda a tiempo y reportar estatus de tareas de forma transparente.
Orientación a la resolución de problemas y curiosidad por profundizar en tecnologías de analítica digital.
Familiaridad con el funcionamiento de GA4 (Google Analytics 4) y nociones de herramientas de UX/Comportamiento (ej. Quantum Metric, Hotjar, ContentSquare, etc.).
Conocimiento fundamental de Google Tag Manager (GTM) (Estructura de contenedores, tags, triggers y variables).

Entendimiento general de cómo viajan los datos desde el sitio web/app hacia las plataformas de analítica.

title: Senior Marketing Analyst | Channel Partner B2B
description:
Skeelo Ciudad de México, Ciudad de México, Mexico

Skeelo es una plataforma digital de lectura que conecta a las personas con e-books, audiolibros y minibooks en una experiencia accesible y personalizada. Desde 2019, utilizamos la tecnología como un medio para democratizar el acceso a la lectura y ampliar su impacto en el desarrollo de las personas.

Creemos que leer va más allá del ocio: es una herramienta poderosa para ampliar horizontes, fortalecer el pensamiento crítico e impulsar el desarrollo humano.

Estamos distribuidos y distribuidas en Brasil y en el mundo, impulsados por la innovación, la agilidad y el aprendizaje continuo, valorando la diversidad y transformando la lectura para adaptarla a la vida de las personas. Hacemos todo esto con transparencia en las relaciones, valentía para innovar, enfoque en alta performance, mirada constante en encantar a clientes y lectores, y entregas ágiles que marcan la diferencia.

Nuestro modelo de trabajo es remote first, aprovechando lo mejor del home office: autorresponsabilidad con autonomía. Sin embargo, también creemos en la conexión y en el intercambio que generan los encuentros presenciales; por eso, realizamos algunos encuentros en São Paulo – SP para fortalecer la conexión con los demás Skeelers. Pero tranquila/o, Skeelo siempre organiza todo por nosotros.

¡El equipo de Marketing necesita a alguien y queremos que seas parte de nuestro equipo!

¿Tu misión? Garantizar la excelencia operativa y el desempeño de las alianzas B2B de Skeelo. Serás la persona responsable de los procesos, cronogramas e indicadores, transformando la planificación estratégica en campañas ejecutadas con calidad. Tu rol será impulsar el crecimiento de los canales actuales y generar los insights necesarios para apoyar a la región.

Así será tu día a día en Skeelo:

Planificar y ejecutar campañas recurrentes con socios B2B, incluyendo la elaboración de briefings, apoyo en la estrategia y estructuración de canales, además del seguimiento de las métricas de éxito de las iniciativas.

Coordinar la planificación y ejecución del lanzamiento de nuevos socios, gestionando playbooks, cronogramas, calendarios de campañas e hitos de entrega con una visión integral del proceso.

Actuar como punto de contacto para socios SMB, construyendo relaciones sólidas y de largo plazo con aliados estratégicos.

Crear y monitorear dashboards e informes de desempeño (métricas de growth, engagement y conversión), transformando los datos en decisiones estratégicas.

Conectar a las áreas internas (Producto, Comercial, Marketing y Branding) para garantizar la alineación y consistencia de las acciones con los socios.

Documentar procesos, asegurando la visibilidad de los proyectos y cronogramas de entrega mediante herramientas de gestión.

Contribuir al desarrollo de nuevas oportunidades de negocio, aportando inteligencia de mercado y análisis comparativos (benchmark), impulsando activamente el crecimiento del engagement a través de los socios, garantizando la recurrencia y una visión de mejora continua de las iniciativas.

Para Esto, Necesitarás

Experiencia previa en Marketing B2B, alianzas estratégicas, canales, growth o marketing digital con enfoque en socios o clientes corporativos.

Experiencia con herramientas de CRM y gestión de proyectos (HubSpot, RD Station, Asana, ClickUp o equivalentes).

Capacidad para gestionar cronogramas de proyectos y lanzamientos de socios con autonomía y organización.

Comunicación proactiva y fluida con múltiples áreas.

Inglés y español avanzados, tanto para lectura y escritura como para conversación.

Y sería un gran plus si también cuentas con:

Experiencia en growth con enfoque B2B y/o gestión de canales con visión de expansión regional.

Experiencia en operaciones LATAM o proyectos de internacionalización, especialmente en la gestión de husos horarios y colaboración con equipos de cultura hispanohablante.

Familiaridad con el sector de Telecomunicaciones o empresas con una fuerte interfaz comercial y un ecosistema de socios.

Conocimiento de herramientas como Google Analytics, Power BI, Tableau o AppsFlyer.

¿Y los beneficios? Cuidamos muy bien de quienes construyen esta historia con nosotros

Modelo de trabajo Remote First, con encuentros presenciales durante el año en São Paulo, con toda la logística cubierta por la empresa.

Bono anual por encima del promedio del mercado.

Días festivos locales, respetando la cultura de cada país.

Horarios flexibles, con hasta 2 horas de flexibilidad al inicio o final del día.

Programas de desarrollo: Ruta de Carrera, Universidad Skeelo y reconocimientos internos.

Día libre durante el mes de tu cumpleaños.

Licencia de maternidad y paternidad según la legislación local.

title: Senior Marketing Analyst | Channel Partner B2B
description:
Skeelo Ciudad de México, Ciudad de México, Mexico

Skeelo es una plataforma digital de lectura que conecta a las personas con e-books, audiolibros y minibooks en una experiencia accesible y personalizada. Desde 2019, utilizamos la tecnología como un medio para democratizar el acceso a la lectura y ampliar su impacto en el desarrollo de las personas.

Creemos que leer va más allá del ocio: es una herramienta poderosa para ampliar horizontes, fortalecer el pensamiento crítico e impulsar el desarrollo humano.

Estamos distribuidos y distribuidas en Brasil y en el mundo, impulsados por la innovación, la agilidad y el aprendizaje continuo, valorando la diversidad y transformando la lectura para adaptarla a la vida de las personas. Hacemos todo esto con transparencia en las relaciones, valentía para innovar, enfoque en alta performance, mirada constante en encantar a clientes y lectores, y entregas ágiles que marcan la diferencia.

Nuestro modelo de trabajo es remote first, aprovechando lo mejor del home office: autorresponsabilidad con autonomía. Sin embargo, también creemos en la conexión y en el intercambio que generan los encuentros presenciales; por eso, realizamos algunos encuentros en São Paulo – SP para fortalecer la conexión con los demás Skeelers. Pero tranquila/o, Skeelo siempre organiza todo por nosotros.

¡El equipo de Marketing necesita a alguien y queremos que seas parte de nuestro equipo!

¿Tu misión? Garantizar la excelencia operativa y el desempeño de las alianzas B2B de Skeelo. Serás la persona responsable de los procesos, cronogramas e indicadores, transformando la planificación estratégica en campañas ejecutadas con calidad. Tu rol será impulsar el crecimiento de los canales actuales y generar los insights necesarios para apoyar a la región.

Así será tu día a día en Skeelo:

Planificar y ejecutar campañas recurrentes con socios B2B, incluyendo la elaboración de briefings, apoyo en la estrategia y estructuración de canales, además del seguimiento de las métricas de éxito de las iniciativas.

Coordinar la planificación y ejecución del lanzamiento de nuevos socios, gestionando playbooks, cronogramas, calendarios de campañas e hitos de entrega con una visión integral del proceso.

Actuar como punto de contacto para socios SMB, construyendo relaciones sólidas y de largo plazo con aliados estratégicos.

Crear y monitorear dashboards e informes de desempeño (métricas de growth, engagement y conversión), transformando los datos en decisiones estratégicas.

Conectar a las áreas internas (Producto, Comercial, Marketing y Branding) para garantizar la alineación y consistencia de las acciones con los socios.

Documentar procesos, asegurando la visibilidad de los proyectos y cronogramas de entrega mediante herramientas de gestión.

Contribuir al desarrollo de nuevas oportunidades de negocio, aportando inteligencia de mercado y análisis comparativos (benchmark), impulsando activamente el crecimiento del engagement a través de los socios, garantizando la recurrencia y una visión de mejora continua de las iniciativas.

Para Esto, Necesitarás

Experiencia previa en Marketing B2B, alianzas estratégicas, canales, growth o marketing digital con enfoque en socios o clientes corporativos.

Experiencia con herramientas de CRM y gestión de proyectos (HubSpot, RD Station, Asana, ClickUp o equivalentes).

Capacidad para gestionar cronogramas de proyectos y lanzamientos de socios con autonomía y organización.

Comunicación proactiva y fluida con múltiples áreas.

Inglés y español avanzados, tanto para lectura y escritura como para conversación.

Y sería un gran plus si también cuentas con:

Experiencia en growth con enfoque B2B y/o gestión de canales con visión de expansión regional.

Experiencia en operaciones LATAM o proyectos de internacionalización, especialmente en la gestión de husos horarios y colaboración con equipos de cultura hispanohablante.

Familiaridad con el sector de Telecomunicaciones o empresas con una fuerte interfaz comercial y un ecosistema de socios.

Conocimiento de herramientas como Google Analytics, Power BI, Tableau o AppsFlyer.

¿Y los beneficios? Cuidamos muy bien de quienes construyen esta historia con nosotros

Modelo de trabajo Remote First, con encuentros presenciales durante el año en São Paulo, con toda la logística cubierta por la empresa.

title: Junior / Semi Senior Marketing Analyst
description:
Azumo is looking for a highly motivated AI-Powered Marketing Analyst to join our marketing team and help grow the Azumo brand and business.

The role is fully remote across Latin America , aligned to your working day.

We are looking for someone who is hands-on, creative, curious, and already uses tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI platforms as part of their daily work.

This is a practical, execution-focused role covering content, social media, AI search visibility, marketing analytics, and marketing operations. You will use AI throughout your workflow to research, create, design, analyze, automate, and improve marketing initiatives.

Your focus will be Azumo. You will learn about our business, customers, services, and market and use that knowledge to expand our reach, strengthen our brand, and generate new opportunities.

You will work closely with the marketing, sales, and leadership teams and have access to leading paid AI, marketing, content, analytics, and creative tools.

What We’re Looking For

We care about how you work, not just which tools you have used.

We want someone who can take an idea and turn it into something real. You should be comfortable researching a topic, creating the content and visuals, publishing or launching the work, measuring the results, and improving the next iteration.

AI should already be a natural part of that process for you.

At the same time, we are not looking for someone who simply generates content and publishes it. Strong judgment, creativity, attention to quality, and an understanding of the audience are essential.

Azumo offers an opportunity to build your marketing career inside a technology company where AI is part of the everyday work.

You Will Have The Opportunity To

Access leading paid AI, marketing, analytics, content, and creative tools.

Work across social media, content, analytics, GEO/AEO, and emerging AI marketing channels.

Experiment with new tools and approaches in real marketing initiatives.

Focus on growing one company and one brand: Azumo.

Work Closely With Experienced Team Members And Company Leadership.

Take ownership of projects and see the direct impact of your work.

Receive training and mentored career development.

Develop skills in emerging areas of marketing as AI changes how people search, discover, and evaluate companies.

Responsibilities

As part of the Azumo marketing team, you will:

Use ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools daily for research, content creation, creative development, analysis, and marketing operations.

Create and repurpose content for LinkedIn and other social media channels, including posts, graphics, carousels, and short-form content.

Create AI-generated images, videos, and other visual content using modern AI creative tools.

Develop and improve articles, case studies, newsletters, presentations, one-pagers, landing pages, and other marketing assets.

Implement GEO and AEO strategies to improve Azumo’s visibility in AI-powered search platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity.

Monitor how Azumo and its competitors appear across traditional and AI search, identify content gaps, and turn those insights into actionable content improvements.

Use AI and analytics tools to build recurring reports covering traffic, social media, campaigns, leads, conversions, AI search visibility, and other relevant marketing KPIs.

Identify opportunities to automate repetitive marketing tasks and improve existing workflows.

Help maintain and update Azumo’s website when needed.

Support other marketing initiatives in collaboration with the marketing, sales, and leadership teams.

Requirements

Mandatory Qualifications

Expert-level English proficiency, both written and conversational.

3+ years of hands-on marketing experience, along with practical experience using generative AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude.

Strong, well-rounded understanding of marketing language, principles and strategy.

Experience creating content for LinkedIn and other social media channels, such as Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, Reddit, or similar platforms.

Comfortable working with marketing data, KPIs, reporting, and performance analysis.

Strong judgment, creativity, attention to detail, and the ability to improve AI-generated work before publication.

Ability to evaluate marketing ideas critically and distinguish between activity, engagement, and meaningful business impact.

Other Qualifications

Ability to connect marketing activities to business objectives and understand how different marketing channels work together.

Experience using ChatGPT, Claude, or similar generative AI tools for research, content creation, design, video production, analysis and marketing operations.

Working experience with HubSpot Marketing Hub.

Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and take ownership of projects in a remote environment.

Understanding of GEO, AEO, SEO, and AI search visibility.

Experience with paid advertising, including Google Ads, Meta Ads, Bing Ads, or emerging AI advertising platforms.

Experience with Webflow or a similar website content management system.

Experience with Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Webmaster Tools and similar analytics platforms.

Experience creating AI-assisted workflows or marketing automations.

The AI-Powered Marketing Analyst will work remotely. Compensation will be commensurate with experience and candidate potential.

Company Benefits Include

Paid time off

100% remote-first culture (work anywhere in Latin America)

U.S. Holidays

Training

Mentored career development

USD remuneration

Profit Share Program

Access to premium AI and marketing tools

Maternity coverage

Based in San Francisco, California, Azumo is a software development company helping organizations build intelligent applications using modern technologies in AI, data, cloud, web, and mobile.

We work with organizations around the world and believe that great talent can come from anywhere.

At Azumo, we strive for excellence and strongly believe in professional and personal growth. We want each individual to be successful and aim to help each person achieve their goals while at Azumo and beyond.
